purpose: Safety/correctness-critical PostgreSQL invariants. Update this file in the same change as any intentional migration that changes a tracked object.

constraints.name: sports_quote_observations_logical_key
definition_contains: unique nulls not distinct (signal_id, venue, requested_delay_ms, trigger_source_fill_id)

constraints.name: sports_shadow_paper_fills_logical_key
definition_contains: unique nulls not distinct (signal_id, requested_delay_ms, notional_tier_usd, trigger_source_fill_id)

functions.name: get_pending_experiment_source_events
definition_contains: order by se.source_ts asc, se.event_key asc

functions.name: apply_verified_paper_settlement
functions.identity_args: uuid, text, text, text, text, timestamp with time zone, numeric, jsonb, numeric, timestamp with time zone, integer, text

functions.name: create_or_get_live_pilot_intent_atomic
definition_contains: select id, status into v_id, v_status

functions.name: update_live_pilot_intent_status_atomic
definition_contains: select * into v_row from public.live_order_intents where id = p_intent_id for update

functions.name: record_http_rate_limit
functions.identity_args: text, timestamp with time zone, text
definition_contains: auth.role() is not null and auth.role() <> 'service_role'

functions.name: reserve_http_request_slot
definition_contains: auth.role() is not null and auth.role() <> 'service_role'

functions.name: find_pending_sports_shadow_signals

functions.name: finalize_sports_shadow_routing_decision
functions.identity_args: uuid, integer, numeric, timestamp with time zone, text, text, text, numeric, numeric, numeric, text, boolean, numeric, text, jsonb, jsonb, text, text, text, uuid, uuid, uuid
